messages:
Nadia: opened PR for a short preflight + troubleshooting checklist for sealed-network Windows installs (HSM + Private VPC). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5432. Focus: preflight checks, PKCS#11 mapping hints, checksum + cert guidance, and a quick 'what to check if installer fails' appendix.

Ethan: Nice. Can we make the checklist extremely terse so support can paste it in a ticket? One-liners for each step would be great.

Nadia: Yep — main doc is a compact checklist at the top, then expanded notes. Example top-level items: backup config, export KMS blob, verify mirror cert SAN, verify checksum, install vendor driver, map PKCS#11, restart agent/service.

Priya: Security note: add the exact registry key customers need to check for driver signing enforcement and an example PowerShell to verify. Many customers hit unsigned-driver blocks.

Nadia: Added registry snippet: ```powershell
Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\IntegrityServices' -Name RequireSignedDrivers
```
And a short GPO note about enforcing signed drivers.

Ethan: Add a one-line hostfile tip for TLS SNI issues if mirror cert only contains internal names. Support often forgets to suggest adding a hosts entry in the installer VM.

Nadia: Added sample PowerShell hostfile line: ```powershell
Add-Content -Path 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts' -Value '10.0.0.45 mirror.internal.local'
```

Priya: For the HSM appendix, please include PKCS#11 example paths for YubiHSM2 and Thales Luna on Windows and Linux, and call out 32-bit vs 64-bit locations. Also indicate vendor middleware install order: driver -> middleware -> agent.

Nadia: Done. Tiny vendor table in the appendix and note to reboot after vendor driver install. Also included a systemd env example for Linux agents and an MSI env var example for Windows.

Ethan: CI note: our windows-smoke runner frequently fails when checksum verification is missing. Can we add a short PowerShell checksum snippet and show how to fail fast in the installer?

Nadia: Added checksum snippet to the preflight:```powershell
$h=(Get-FileHash .\\redwood-installer.zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; if ($h -ne 'REPLACE_SHA256') { Write-Error 'checksum mismatch'; Exit 1 }
```
And a note that the installer will abort on mismatch.

link-bot: link-checker/5432 started. Found 1 broken relative link in docs/hsm/windows-appendix.md#pkcs11-windows -> suggest rename anchor to pkcs11-windows-paths. Also found a bad link to /guides/migrate-linux -> suggest /guides/migrate-from-linux.

Nadia: Fixed both anchors/links and pushed. Thanks for catching that.

Priya: Tiny wording nit: replace any wording like "open ports" with precise guidance: "allow egress to mirror host on port 443 (HTTPS) and 445 (SMB) as applicable".

Nadia: Updated wording across the doc. Also added an SMB troubleshooting one-liner for credential issues: ```powershell
net use \\\\\\mirror\\\\artifacts /user:DOMAIN\\\\svc_redwood P@ssw0rd /persistent:no
```

Ethan: Can you add an entry in the appendix for the three most common failure messages and the exact command to collect logs for each? e.g., PKCS11 path not found -> check agent log path; unsigned driver -> Windows Event Log snippet; mirror TLS mismatch -> curl/Invoke-WebRequest with -SkipCertificateCheck to repro.

Nadia: Added Appendix B with three failure scenarios and collection commands:
- PKCS11 path missing: `Get-Content C:\\ProgramData\\redwood\\agent\\logs\\agent.log | Select-String pkcs11`
- Unsigned driver error: check `Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 100 | Where-Object {$_.Message -like '*driver*'}`
- TLS SNI mismatch: `Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://mirror.internal.local/health -SkipCertificateCheck` (for repro only).

smoke-bot: windows-smoke queued re-run on branch. Will post results.

Priya: LGTM from security side after those edits. Approve pending green smoke. I'll add a short blurb about restricting the SMB service account to read-only on the share.

Ethan: LGTM for infra. Tiny nit: include an example of the minimal firewall/nftables rule for mirror host (we often get asked).

Nadia: Added minimal nftables/iptables snippets and the GCP/VPC security group example (allow from 10.0.0.0/16 to mirror on tcp/443).

link-bot: link-checker/5432 completed. No broken links remaining.

Nadia: Thanks all. If smoke is green I'll merge and follow up with a short 'ticket-ready paste' condensed checklist PR for support to use in customer threads. Tagging @Ethan @Priya for visibility. :rocket:
